docs(pdt42): accept deliberate deviations with :::ignore

## Intent

The hints for deviations accepted on purpose kept E3 and D1 open in `pdt42 guide` and cluttered `pdt42 validate`. Mark them as accepted, each with its reason, so the guide shows the real progress.

## Key changes

- E3 ignores H002 (no asset is hard to imitate, KD-04).
- E2 ignores H101 (GitHub has no role) and H102 (six peer roles), both from KD-10, because the entities live there.
- The development plan refers to the directives.

## Dependencies and side effects

- A directive applies to the whole file: a new H101, H102 or H002 in the same file stays hidden. The development plan notes this.
